description: Machine-readable catalog of scanners the toolkit wraps. An agent reads this to know what tools exist, how to invoke them, their output format, and exit codes.

output.enrichment: combined.sarif is post-processed with security-severity bands (GitHub crit/high/med/low) and partialFingerprints for dedup/baselines
output.stdout: machine channel (json/sarif when not a tty)

tools.note: scans the working tree AND full git history (set RS_GIT_HISTORY=0 to skip history); honors an optional .gitleaks.toml allowlist/baseline

static analysis via Opengrep (LGPL-2.1 fork of the Semgrep OSS engine; no account/telemetry). Image built locally from scanners/sast/Dockerfile. Ruleset overridable via RS_OPENGREP_CONFIG (default p/default; registry rulesets are third-party licensed)
GitHub Actions security audit (template injection, unpinned actions, over-broad GITHUB_TOKEN, credential persistence). Runs offline; scans .github/workflows
Software Bill of Materials (SPDX-JSON by default; set RS_SBOM_FORMAT). An inventory artifact, NOT SARIF findings, so it is standalone and not part of `scan all`
